scope: Three frozen V17 alighted waiting roots. Fit, ordered chains, physical MCT, observation rules, deadline, and 120-second margin are shared. No new sources or retrospective tuning.
primary: support_through_wait, with V17 support menu, actual-second scoring, and a waiting reference that includes eligible future through departures.

arms.through_seconds: V17 direct-only candidates, old A/B waiting estimate, and score interpolation at observed seconds.
arms.support_old_wait: V17 broad and support-eligible extra candidates, same old waiting estimate and interpolation.
arms.support_through_wait: Identical support menu, scores and margin, with through departures included in the wait estimate.
arms.through_updated_wait: Same enhanced waiting comparison on the through-only menu. Secondary ablation.

waiting_model: Backward recursion over projected first-departure offers. Eligible future through trips compete with the original A/B offers. Update from public time and receipts. Use the original margin, A/B projection, and conditional committed path scores. This local model is not a full-network bound.
paired_worlds: 256 per root, at [20261118, int(date), query, decision, 0], drawn after freezing rules. All arms use a common fixed root+10-second release if their measured construction and binding fit, before physical readiness. Charge cold per-arm screening, table preparation, binding and measured execution.
gate: Primary arm only. Upper bound its expected policy-minus-hindsight with the V16 complement product test at alpha=.05/3 across the three roots. Full causal regret is at most that expectation. Other comparisons are descriptive. Do not extend the tape or select another primary from these results.
historical_seconds: Replay only the three existing records, keep unresolved departures censored for their respective menus. Actual exact-second actions assume the existing instantaneous-response model.
